completion_conditions: Shiki platform decisions are docs/adr/SADR-NNNN-<slug>.md and live platform citations resolve through SADR.
Target repositories keep docs/adr/NNNN-<slug>.md product decisions without ambiguity or forced renumbering.
Fresh installs and stamped upgrades preserve target ADR bytes and pass validation.
A legacy Shiki ADR is removed only when its install-stamp path and digest match, otherwise the upgrade stops before the first write.
Unit, shell, validation, fresh-install, and upgrade suites pass in CI on the exact PR head.

context_and_impact.evidence: CI-08 equivalent exploration is recorded in Goal #322 and this draft: installer write order and stamp helpers; platform ADR filenames 0001-0018; citation resolver; root, docs, scripts, workflow, prompt, packaging, and repo-local skill citations; CubeShare product ADR collisions and valid legacy stamp digests; fresh-install and upgrade verification surfaces.
context_and_impact.lock_check: git grep traced every live ADR 0001-0018 citation and legacy docs/adr/0001-0018 path. Historical .shiki evidence was identified separately and excluded from semantic rewriting.

decisions: Use SADR for Shiki platform decisions and retain ADR for target product decisions. Collision-only refusal leaves targets unupgradable; per-target renumbering destroys stable platform identity.
Rename existing platform records to SADR-0001 through SADR-0018 and record the decision as SADR-0019. Update current citations, resolver code, fixtures, packaging, and operator guidance together.
Treat frozen .shiki evidence as history and do not mechanically rewrite completed Goal, Plan, Task, Ledger, Report, Handoff, or Runner prose.
Plan all legacy removals before any write. A present legacy path is deletable only when a readable existing stamp contains the path and its digest equals the current file digest.
Absent, unreadable, malformed, incomplete, or mismatching ownership evidence fails closed with all blockers and a byte-identical target tree.
After clean preflight, delete only proven legacy paths, copy SADRs, and refresh the stamp with SADR digests and no removed legacy path.
Keep namespace, resolver, shipped templates, and atomic cleanup in one vertical slice because no partial branch is independently safe and valid.
grill_with_docs.source: Architecture review and Requirements Definition for GitHub Goal #322 on 2026-08-07 after a real CubeShare upgrade produced ambiguous ADR references and a red full suite.

non_goals: Renumbering or rewriting target product ADRs.
Rewriting historical .shiki evidence that accurately records the former namespace.
Deleting a target-owned file without exact install-stamp ownership evidence.
Changing Guardian, Contract Approval, lock, CCA, or MergeGate semantics.
Repairing the separate installer defect that overwrites a target .gitignore during upgrade.
outcome: Shiki platform decisions use a collision-free SADR namespace, while target repositories keep their existing ADR namespace. Fresh installs and stamped upgrades remain deterministic, and an upgrade removes a legacy numeric Shiki ADR only when its recorded install-stamp digest proves that the file is still platform-owned and unchanged.

spec_freeze.source: Operator explicitly replied '承認' on 2026-08-07 after being shown the schema-valid frozen-plan draft and informed that this creates the operator-only Spec Freeze approval record.

acceptance_checks: The platform tree has unique SADR-0001 through SADR-0019, no legacy numeric Shiki platform ADR file, and every live SADR citation resolves exactly once.
The validator resolves target ADR NNNN to docs/adr/NNNN-*.md and platform SADR NNNN to docs/adr/SADR-NNNN-*.md; fixtures prove both namespaces may reuse a number.

Current platform references in root governance docs, docs, scripts, workflows/prompts, .codex/skills/shiki/SKILL.md, and packaging use SADR or explicit generic target-ADR examples. Historical .shiki records remain unchanged except this Goal's lifecycle evidence.
A fresh-install fixture with product ADRs 0013-0018 preserves their bytes, installs SADR-0001 through SADR-0019, stamps SADR paths, and validates.

A forced-upgrade fixture with product collisions plus matching stamped legacy Shiki ADRs deletes only legacy platform paths, preserves product ADR bytes, installs SADRs, and removes legacy paths from the refreshed stamp.
Parameterized absent, unreadable/malformed, missing-digest, and digest-mismatch cases report all blockers before ShikiError; recursive snapshots prove no filesystem byte changed.
No legacy path means an absent stamp does not block; a non-force install does not silently delete existing files.
Red-green-refactor and a structured code-review verdict are recorded, with all blocking findings repaired and re-reviewed.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests, control-plane and adversarial shell suites, validate_shiki, and fresh-install/upgrade tests pass locally and in CI on the exact head.
non_goals: Deleting any legacy path without exact stamp path and digest match.
Changing approval, CCA, MergeGate, lock, runtime, or repair semantics.
tasks.scope: Rename Shiki platform decision records to SADR-0001 through SADR-0018; add SADR-0019; update current citations, packaging metadata, documentation, workflows, prompts, repo-local skill guidance, and the reference validator for separate ADR/SADR namespaces; add an installer preflight that inventories legacy numeric Shiki ADR paths and authorizes deletion only from matching existing install-stamp path digests before any write; then apply authorized cleanup, install SADRs, refresh the stamp, and prove fresh-install plus CubeShare-shaped collision-upgrade behavior with TDD.
